svg.title: S2GO temporal transformer with side inputs entering at correct sub-blocks
svg.desc: Decoder layer where current queries flow top-to-bottom through the layer, past queries enter only at self-attention as a side input, and image features enter only at cross-attention as a side input. Residuals branch from input lines via T-junctions and land at Add and norm steps. Block repeats six times.
svg.text: Only the current queries enter at the top — others are side inputs

g.text: Opacity-δ propagator pushes top-256 back to memory queue
